definitions.explanation: A large black waterbird that dives to catch fish. Found along rivers and lakes throughout Japan, and closely associated with the traditional practice of cormorant fishing.

examples.japanese: {川鵜|かわう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{潜|もぐ}って→潜る：03931_moguru⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捕|と}った→捕る：28715_toru⟧。
examples.english: A cormorant dove into the water and caught a fish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{川岸|かわぎし}→川岸：24545_kawagishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{岩|いわ}→岩：00850_iwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{川鵜|かわう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{羽|はね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げて→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧⟦{乾|かわ}かしていた→乾かす：01931_kawakasu⟧。
examples.english: A cormorant was spreading its wings to dry on a rock by the riverbank.

examples.japanese: {長良川|ながらがわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鵜飼|うか}い→鵜飼い：27920_ukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧{川鵜|かわう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{鮎|あゆ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捕|と}る→捕る：28715_toru⟧。
examples.english: In cormorant fishing on the Nagara River, trained cormorants are used to catch sweetfish.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧ (river) and ⟦{鵜|う}→鵜：19870_u⟧ (cormorant). The cormorant is a skilled diving bird that can swallow fish whole. Its black plumage and habit of drying its wings with them spread wide are distinctive features seen along Japanese waterways.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {川鵜|かわう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{群|む}れ→群れ：00298_mure⟧: flock of cormorants
- {川鵜|かわう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{潜|もぐ}る→潜る：03931_moguru⟧: cormorant dives
- {川鵜|かわう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{羽|はね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧: cormorant spreads its wings

CULTURAL NOTE:
Cormorant fishing (⟦{鵜飼|うか}い→鵜飼い：27920_ukai⟧) is a traditional fishing method over 1,300 years old, designated as an Important Intangible Folk Cultural Property. The most famous location is the Nagara River in Gifu, where {鵜匠|うしょう} (cormorant masters) fish by torchlight from boats. The poet Matsuo Basho wrote about it.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {海鵜|うみう}: Japanese cormorant — the species actually used in ⟦{鵜飼|うか}い→鵜飼い：27920_ukai⟧, found along the coast
- ⟦{鵜|う}→鵜：19870_u⟧: cormorant — the general term for any cormorant
